data.metaTitle: Donate 2 % of your tax to us (2018)
data.metaDescription: In 2018 the civic association Hradiská is again applying for 2 % of your taxes — last year it bought metal detectors, a drone and other equipment.

children.text: In 2018, too, we are applying for 2 % of your taxes. Last year we used this money to buy the equipment we needed (metal detectors, a drone and the like), which we use on excavations with archaeologists, whom we help in this way. We also fund our own activities from this money, for example making and installing information panels. This year we plan to prepare and publish a new edited volume, Hradiská – svedkovia dávnych čias (Hillforts – Witnesses of Ancient Times), and other publications as well.

Thank you for every euro you give.
